description: Fetch one Sigstore Rekor transparency-log entry by its uuid — the 80-hex id rekor_search_by_hash returns — decoded into entry kind, signed artifact digest, signature and signing certificate, integration time, and the Merkle inclusion proof that makes the entry tamper-evident. Keyless. Example: rekor_entry({ uuid: "362f8ecba72f4326166cbd2dd2eeb3c2b0f93a02c9b369a18baad8e71104ba172c64b0d12c900f4c" }).

uuid.description: Rekor entry uuid, 64 or 80 hex characters.

name: rekor_entry
